name: Eusapia
anti_trude_vector: Stratigraphic twin-cross-section Canvas2D + Confraternity vertical shaft state machine + causal mimesis-inversion ledger in custom <eusapia-*> DOM vocabulary

inner_arch.summary: To strip all abruptness from the passage between life and death, Eusapia builds an underground replica of itself populated by dried yellow-parchment skeletons continuing carefree trades; yet as the dead remodel their subterranean city and the Hooded Brothers report each novelty upward, living Eusapia copies its necropolis until mimesis reverses (lower_to_upper) and no one can tell who is alive and who is dead.
invariants: Twin Subterranean Copy: Eight mirrored bays align sunlit upper Eusapia with vaulted underground Eusapia where dried corpses continue carefree trades (banqueters, trumpeters, clockmakers among stopped clocks, barbers lathering cheekbones, mezzo-sopranos finishing scores, dancers, bank tellers, beauties).

Sole Crossing by the Confraternity of the Hooded Brothers: Living citizens cannot enter the necropolis directly (livingDirectEntryAllowed === false); only the Hooded Brothers descend the central shaft to place the dead and ascend with reports of underground innovations.

Causal Mimesis Reversal & Indistinguishability: Underground innovations by the dead induce upper-city copying cycles, reversing mimesisDirection from 'upper_to_lower' to 'lower_to_upper', raising hoodedDeadRatio to 1.0, and sealing whoIsAliveDistinguishable === false.

stones.label: Twin Underground Copy & Carefree Skeletons
stones.calvino_anchor: Dried corpses of skin and yellow bone sit around loaded banquet tables, play trumpets, tend stopped clocks, lather cheekbones, finish mezzo-soprano scores, dance, and count gilt tokens.

stones.label: Confraternity of the Hooded Brothers
stones.calvino_anchor: No living person enters underground Eusapia except the Hooded Brothers who carry the dead down the shaft and report subterranean changes.

stones.label: Mimesis Inversion & Twin Indistinguishability
stones.calvino_anchor: The dead innovate below and the living copy the underground city above until in the twin cities there is no longer any way of knowing who is alive and who is dead.
